Owen and Max had great fun there. They took many photos at the old town. Both of them like fish and juice. Also, the old railway is now a bike path.
Owen likes sunny days best. Owen wants to be a driver in the future. Life is full of small surprises. Also, the viewing platform opens at sunrise.
Owen usually has fish for breakfast. Max is interested in dancing. Last Wednesday, Owen and Max went to the bus stop. The children squeal with delight at the puppy's tricks.
The bus stop is one of the best places in the city. Owen wrote about the day in the diary. It takes twenty minutes to get to the bus stop by bike.
